chapter.li: LEChapter1 Verse1 And now I, Moroni, proceed to give an account of those ancient inhabitants who were destroyed by the hand of the Lord upon the face of this north country. VerseEnd Verse2 And I take mine account from the twenty and four plates which were found by the people of Limhi, which is called The Book of Ether. VerseEnd Verse3 And as I suppose that the first part of this record — which speaks concerning the creation of the world, and also of Adam, and an account from that time even to the great tower, and whatsoever things transpired among the children of men until that time — is had among the Jews, VerseEnd Verse4 therefore I do not write those things which transpired from the days of Adam until that time; but they are had upon the plates, and whoso findeth them, the same will have power that he may get the full account. VerseEnd Verse5 But behold, I give not the full account, but a part of the account I give, from the tower down until they were destroyed. VerseEnd

Verse6 And on this wise do I give the account: He that wrote this record was Ether, and he was a descendant of Coriantor. VerseEnd Verse7 And Coriantor was the son of Moron, VerseEnd Verse8 and Moron was the son of Ethem, VerseEnd Verse9 and Ethem was the son of Ahah, VerseEnd Verse10 and Ahah was the son of Seth, VerseEnd Verse11 and Seth was the son of Shiblon, VerseEnd Verse12 and Shiblon was the son of Com, VerseEnd Verse13 and Com was the son of Coriantum, VerseEnd Verse14 and Coriantum was the son of Amnigaddah, VerseEnd Verse15 and Amnigaddah was the son of Aaron. VerseEnd Verse16 And Aaron was a descendant of Heth, who was the son of Hearthom. VerseEnd Verse17 And Hearthom was the son of Lib, VerseEnd Verse18 and Lib was the son of Kish, VerseEnd Verse19 and Kish was the son of Corom, VerseEnd Verse20 and Corom was the son of Levi, VerseEnd Verse21 and Levi was the son of Kim, VerseEnd Verse22 and Kim was the son of Morionton. VerseEnd Verse23 And Morionton was a descendant of Riplakish, VerseEnd Verse24 and Riplakish was the son of Shez, VerseEnd Verse25 and Shez was the son of Heth, VerseEnd Verse26 and Heth was the son of Com, VerseEnd Verse27 and Com was the son of Coriantum, VerseEnd Verse28 and Coriantum was the son of Emer, VerseEnd Verse29 and Emer was the son of Omer, VerseEnd Verse30 and Omer was the son of Shule, VerseEnd Verse31 and Shule was the son of Kib, VerseEnd Verse32 and Kib was the son of Orihah, who was the son of Jared, VerseEnd Verse33 which Jared came forth with his brother and their families, with some others and their families, from the great tower, at the time the Lord confounded the language of the people and sware in his wrath that they should be scattered upon all the face of the earth. And according to the word of the Lord, the people were scattered. VerseEnd

Verse34 And the brother of Jared being a large and a mighty man, and being a man highly favored of the Lord, for Jared his brother said unto him, Cry unto the Lord that he will not confound us that we may not understand our words. VerseEnd Verse35 And it came to pass that the brother of Jared did cry unto the Lord, and the Lord had compassion upon Jared. Therefore, he did not confound the language of Jared, and Jared and his brother were not confounded. VerseEnd Verse36 Then Jared said unto his brother, Cry again unto the Lord, and it may be that he will turn away his anger from them who are our friends, that he confound not their language. VerseEnd Verse37 And it came to pass that the brother of Jared did cry unto the Lord, and the Lord had compassion upon their friends and their families also, that they were not confounded. VerseEnd Verse38 And it came to pass that Jared spake again unto his brother, saying, Go and inquire of the Lord whether he will drive us out of the land. And if he will drive us out of the land, cry unto him, Whither shall we go? And who knoweth but the Lord will carry us forth into a land which is choice above all the earth. And if it so be, let us be faithful unto the Lord, that we may receive it for our inheritance. VerseEnd Verse39 And it came to pass that the brother of Jared did cry unto the Lord according to that which had been spoken by the mouth of Jared. VerseEnd Verse40 And it came to pass that the Lord did hear the brother of Jared and had compassion upon him, and said unto him, VerseEnd Verse41 Go to and gather together 2PSI thy flocks, both male and female of every kind, and also of the seed of the earth of every kind, and 2PSI thy family, and also Jared 2PSI thy brother and his family, and also 2PSI thy friends and their families, and the friends of Jared and their families. VerseEnd

Verse42 And when 2PSI thou hast done this, 2PSI thou shalt go at the head of them down into the valley which is northward, and there will I meet 2PSI thee, and I will go before 2PSI thee into a land which is choice above all the land of the earth. VerseEnd Verse43 And there will I bless 2PSI thee and 2PSI thy seed, and raise up unto me — of 2PSI thy seed, and the seed of 2PSI thy brother, and they who shall go with 2PSI thee — a great nation. And there shall be none greater than the nation which I will raise up unto me of 2PSI thy seed upon all the face of the earth. And this I will do unto 2PSI thee because this long time which 2PP ye have cried unto me. VerseEnd

LEChapter2 Verse1 And it came to pass that Jared, and his brother, and their families, and also the friends of Jared and his brother and their families, went down into the valley which was northward (and the name of the valley was Nimrod, being called after the mighty hunter) with their flocks which they had gathered together, male and female of every kind. VerseEnd Verse2 And they did also lay snares and catch fowls of the air. And they did also prepare a vessel in the which they did carry with them the fish of the waters. VerseEnd Verse3 And they did also carry with them Deseret, which (by interpretation) is a honey bee. And thus they did carry with them swarms of bees, and all manner of that which was upon the face of the land, seeds of every kind. VerseEnd

Verse4 And it came to pass that when they had come down into the valley of Nimrod, the Lord came down and talked with the brother of Jared. And he was in a cloud, and the brother of Jared saw him not. VerseEnd Verse5 And it came to pass that the Lord commanded them that they should go forth into the wilderness, yea, into that quarter where there never had man been. And it came to pass that the Lord did go before them, and did talk with them as he stood in a cloud, and gave directions whither they should travel. VerseEnd Verse6 And it came to pass that they did travel in the wilderness and did build barges in which they did cross many waters, being directed continually by the hand of the Lord. VerseEnd Verse7 And the Lord would not suffer that they should stop beyond the sea in the wilderness, but he would that they should come forth even unto the land of promise, which was choice above all other lands, which the Lord God had preserved for a righteous people. VerseEnd Verse8 And he had sworn in his wrath unto the brother of Jared that whoso should possess this land of promise, from that time henceforth and for ever should serve him, the true and only God, or they should be swept off when the fullness of his wrath should come upon them. VerseEnd

Verse9 And now we can behold the decrees of God concerning this land, that it is a land of promise, and whatsoever nation shall possess it shall serve God or they shall be swept off when the fullness of his wrath shall come upon them. And the fullness of his wrath cometh upon them when they are ripened in iniquity. VerseEnd Verse10 For behold, this is a land which is choice above all other lands. Wherefore, he that doth possess it shall serve God or shall be swept off, for it is the everlasting decree of God. And it is not until the fullness of iniquity among the children of the land that they are swept off. VerseEnd Verse11 And this cometh unto 2PP you, O 2PP ye gentiles, that 2PP ye may know the decrees of God, that 2PP ye may repent and not continue in 2PP your iniquities until the fullness be come, that 2PP ye may not bring down the fullness of the wrath of God upon 2PP you as the inhabitants of the land hath hitherto done. VerseEnd Verse12 Behold, this is a choice land; and whatsoever nation shall possess it shall be free from bondage, and from captivity, and from all other nations under Heaven if they will but serve the God of the land, who is Jesus Christ, who has been manifested by the things which we have written. VerseEnd

Verse13 And now I proceed with my record. For behold, it came to pass that the Lord did bring Jared and his brethren forth, even to that great sea which divideth the lands. And as they came to the sea, they pitched their tents, and they called the name of the place Moriancumer. And they dwelt in tents upon the seashore for the space of four years. VerseEnd Verse14 And it came to pass at the end of the four years that the Lord came again unto the brother of Jared, and stood in a cloud and talked with him. And for the space of three hours did the Lord talk with the brother of Jared, and chastened him because he remembered not to call upon the name of the Lord. VerseEnd Verse15 And the brother of Jared repented of the evil which he had done and did call upon the name of the Lord for his brethren who were with him. And the Lord said unto him, I will forgive 2PSI thee and 2PSI thy brethren of their sins, but 2PSI thou shalt not sin anymore. For 2PP ye shall remember that my spirit will not always strive with man. Wherefore, if 2PP ye will sin until 2PP ye are fully ripe, 2PP ye shall be cut off from the presence of the Lord. And these are my thoughts upon the land which I shall give 2PP you for 2PP your inheritance, for it shall be a land of choice above all other lands. VerseEnd

Verse16 And the Lord said, Go to work and build after the manner of barges which 2PP ye have hitherto built. And it came to pass that the brother of Jared did go to work, and also his brethren, and built barges after the manner which they had built, according to the instructions of the Lord. And they were small and they were light upon the water, even like unto the lightness of a fowl upon the water. VerseEnd Verse17 And they were built after a manner that they were exceeding tight, even that they would hold water like unto a dish; and the bottom thereof was tight like unto a dish, and the sides thereof was tight like unto a dish, and the ends thereof were peaked, and the top thereof was tight like unto a dish, and the length thereof was the length of a tree, and the door thereof, when it was shut, was tight like unto a dish. VerseEnd Verse18 And it came to pass that the brother of Jared cried unto the Lord, saying, O Lord, I have performed the work which 2PSI thou hast commanded me and I have made the barges according as 2PSI thou hast directed me. VerseEnd Verse19 And behold, O Lord, in them there is no light. Whither shall we steer? And also we shall perish, for in them we cannot breathe save it is the air which is in them; therefore we shall perish. VerseEnd Verse20 And the Lord said unto the brother of Jared, Behold, 2PSI thou shalt make a hole in the top thereof, and also in the bottom thereof, and when 2PG thou shalt suffer for air, 2PG thou shalt unstop the hole thereof and receive air. And if it so be that the water come in upon 2PG thee, behold, 2PP ye shall stop the hole thereof, that 2PP ye may not perish in the flood. VerseEnd

Verse21 And it came to pass that the brother of Jared did so according as the Lord had commanded. VerseEnd Verse22 And he cried again unto the Lord, saying, O Lord, behold, I have done even as 2PSI thou hast commanded me and I have prepared the vessels for my people. And behold, there is no light in them. Behold, O Lord, wilt 2PSI thou suffer that we shall cross this great water in darkness? VerseEnd Verse23 And the Lord said unto the brother of Jared, What will 2PP ye that I should do that 2PP ye may have light in 2PP your vessels? For behold, 2PP ye cannot have windows, for they will be dashed in pieces. Neither shall 2PP ye take fire with 2PP you, for 2PP ye shall not go by the light of fire. Nevertheless, I will bring 2PP you up again out of the depths of the sea, for the winds have gone forth out of my mouth, and also the rains and the floods have I sent forth. VerseEnd Verse25 And behold, I prepare 2PP you against these things, for how be it, 2PP ye cannot cross this great deep save I prepare 2PP you against the waves of the sea, and the winds which have gone forth, and the floods which shall come. Therefore, what will 2PP ye that I should prepare for 2PP you, that 2PP ye may have light when 2PP ye are swallowed up in the depths of the sea? VerseEnd

Verse13 And when he had said these words, behold, the Lord shewed himself unto him and said, Because 2PSI thou knowest these things, 2PSF ye are redeemed from the Fall. Verse17 And now as I, Moroni, said I could not make a full account of these things which are written, therefore it sufficeth me to say that Jesus shewed himself unto this man in the spirit, even after the manner and in the likeness of the same body even as he shewed himself unto the Nephites. VerseEnd Verse18 And he ministered unto him even as he ministered unto the Nephites, and all this that this man might know that he was God, because of the many great works which the Lord had shewed unto him. VerseEnd Verse19 And because of the knowledge of this man, he could not be kept from beholding within the veil. And he saw the finger of Jesus, which when he saw, he fell with fear, for he knew that it was the finger of the Lord. And he had faith no longer, for he knew, nothing doubting. VerseEnd Verse20 Wherefore, having this perfect knowledge of God, he could not be kept from within the veil. Therefore, he saw Jesus, and he did minister unto him. VerseEnd

Verse21 And it came to pass that the Lord said unto the brother of Jared, Behold, 2PSI thou shalt not suffer these things which 2PSF ye have seen and heard to go forth unto the world until the time cometh that I shall glorify my name in the flesh. Therefore, the Lord could not withhold anything from him, for he knew that the Lord could shew him all things. VerseEnd

Verse27 And the Lord said unto him, Write these things and seal them up, and I will shew them in mine own due time unto the children of men. VerseEnd Verse28 And it came to pass that the Lord commanded him that he should seal up the two stones which he had received and shew them not until the Lord should shew them unto the children of men. VerseEnd LEChapter4 Verse1 And the Lord commanded the brother of Jared to go down out of the mount from the presence of the Lord and write the things which he had seen. And they were forbidden to come unto the children of men until after that he should be lifted up upon the cross. And for this cause did king Benjamin keep them, that they should not come unto the world until after Christ should shew himself unto his people. VerseEnd Verse2 And after that Christ truly had shewed himself unto his people, he commanded that they should be made manifest. VerseEnd

Verse3 And now, after that they have all dwindled in unbelief and there is none save it be the Lamanites — and they have rejected the gospel of Christ — therefore I am commanded that I should hide them up again in the earth. VerseEnd Verse4 Behold, I have written upon these plates the very things which the brother of Jared saw. And there never was greater things made manifest than that which was made manifest unto the brother of Jared. VerseEnd Verse5 Wherefore, the Lord hath commanded me to write them, and I have written them. And he commanded me that I should seal them up. And he also hath commanded that I should seal up the interpretation thereof; wherefore, I have sealed up the interpreters according to the commandment of the Lord. VerseEnd Verse6 For the Lord said unto me, They shall not go forth unto the gentiles until the day that they shall repent of their iniquity and become clean before the Lord. VerseEnd Verse7 And in that day that they shall exercise faith in me, saith the Lord, even as the brother of Jared did, that they may become sanctified in me, then will I manifest unto them the things which the brother of Jared saw, even to the unfolding unto them all my revelations, saith Jesus Christ, the Son of God the Father of the heavens, and of the earth, and all things that in them are. VerseEnd

Verse8 And he that will contend against the word of the Lord, let him be accursed. And he that shall deny these things, let him be accursed. For unto them will I shew no greater things, saith Jesus Christ; for I am he who speaketh, VerseEnd Verse9 and at my command the heavens are opened and are shut, and at my word the earth shall shake, and at my command the inhabitants thereof shall pass away, even so as by fire. VerseEnd Verse10 And he that believeth not my words believeth not my disciples. And if it so be that I do not speak, judge 2PP ye, for 2PP ye shall know that it is I that speaketh at the last day. VerseEnd Verse11 But he that believeth these things which I have spoken, him will I visit with the manifestations of my spirit. VerseEnd Verse12 And whatsoever thing persuadeth men to do good is of me, for good cometh of none save it be of me. I am the same that leadeth men to all good.

He that will not believe my words will not believe me, that I am. And he that will not believe me will not believe the Father who sent me. For behold, I am the Father. I am the light, and the life, and the truth of the world. VerseEnd Verse13 Come unto me, O 2PP ye gentiles, and I will shew unto 2PP you the greater things, the knowledge which is hid up because of unbelief. VerseEnd Verse14 Come unto me, O 2PP ye house of Israel, and it shall be made manifest unto 2PP you how great things the Father hath laid up for 2PP you from the foundation of the world; and it hath not come unto 2PP you because of unbelief. VerseEnd Verse19 And blessed is he that is found faithful unto my name at the last day, for he shall be lifted up to dwell in the kingdom prepared for him from the foundation of the world. And behold, it is I that hath spoken it. Amen. VerseEnd
